decisions.reason: Using separate mint-success messages for referral scenarios does not change how fiat buyers access commissions, prizes, tickets, wallets, or dashboards.
The source changes confirmation-message presentation, not the Transak provider, supported methods, conversion, availability, or post-payment mint behavior.
Scenario-specific success copy does not change background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements.
The decision does not alter which payment methods are available or selectable.
Separate referral-scenario confirmation messages do not change ETH payment, swap, pricing, mint, or refund semantics.
The source concerns referral-dependent mint-success copy and does not change optional tipping or its separate post-mint transaction.
The mint price and no-hidden-fees commitment remain unchanged.
The selected confirmation wording describes existing reward outcomes but does not modify the primary-sale allocation amounts or recipients.
The source changes success-message specificity, not the USDC approval or NFT mint flow.
The NFT ebook product type and unlimited supply model remain valid without modification.
Scenario-specific success messages do not alter payment-currency disclosure or ETH/USDC selection.
The source does not change any public counter, mint statistic, referral statistic, or prize-pool display rule.
